text:
Sam: We're planning a small model-serving rollout at 21:00 UTC tonight (v2.14->v2.15). Primary changes: observability panel tweaks + two alert threshold updates. Can folks confirm smoke-watch and quick checks?
Anya: I can take primary watch from 20:50-22:30 UTC. I'll run smoke queries and check traces. :thumbsup:
Kevin: I'll add a short trace query and a latency percentile snapshot you'll want. Can you share exact dashboard/grafana panel ids?
Sam: Dashboard link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/serving/serving-overview?orgId=1 panelId=42. Panels to tweak: `p95_latency`, `token_rate`.
Liz: I can be on rollback standby. Where's the rollback runbook?
Sam: Rollback runbook: https://confluence.internal/redwood/runbooks/serving-rollback
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy job `ci/deploy/serving:v2.15` queued to start 21:00 UTC. ETA ~5m. Watch: @Anya @Liz @Kevin
Anya: Quick smoke checklist I'm going to run:
- curl health endpoint: `curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood/v1/health`
- run sample gen: `python tools/smoke_gen.py --prompt "hello" --model serving-v2.15`
- verify KV cache hit-rate panel
Kevin: Trace query (Datadog): `trace("service:serving AND resource.name:generate").by("http.status_code").rollup("p95", "1m")` — check p95 baseline before and after.
Kevin: For alerts, suggest temp thresholds for rollout: `serving_high_latency_p95` from `700ms` -> `1200ms` (during first 10m) then revert. We'll mute paging but keep slack notify.
Anya: I'll mute paging on that alert during canary window and leave slack hook. Will document in alert comment.
Liz: If we need to rollback: `kubectl -n serving rollout undo deployment/serving-api --to-revision=213` and then confirm `kubectl get pods -l app=serving -o wide` — I'll run that if we see >=30% error rate or sustained p95 > 1.2s for 5m.
Sam: Post-deploy checks (quick): 1) health ok 2) p50/p95 within expected 3) no spike in 5xx 4) trace spans not showing errors
Anya: Post-deploy I'll paste short results here. Planning a 10m canary with 10% traffic then 50% then 100% if green. :ok_hand:
Kevin: Adding one more: sample token-per-second rate should not drop >10% from baseline. I'll post baseline numbers at 20:55 UTC.
deploy-bot: Deploy `ci/deploy/serving:v2.15` started at 21:00 UTC — jobs: build(OK), e2e(smoke) running
Anya: e2e smoke passed locally, running against canary
Sam: thanks everyone. Tag me if anything flaps. I'll do the final go/no-go at 21:02 UTC after canary ramp.
Liz: noted. I'll be in the watch channel and ready for rollback.
Kevin: baseline p95: 430ms, p50: 80ms, tps: 210 — posting again at 20:55
Anya: Post-deploy: canary traffic at 10% for 10m — no errors, p95 450ms, tps 205, all good :party:
Sam: Go to 50% at 21:12 UTC. Keep monitoring.
deploy-bot: Deploy completed to 50% at 21:12 UTC; rollout continuing
Anya: After 50% -> 100% ramp: p95 480ms, no increase in 5xx. I unmuted pagers at 21:25 UTC.
Sam: 100% complete at 21:30 UTC. Thanks team. I'll open a short post-deploy note with dashboards and logs.
Liz: Closing handoff — I'll follow up with post-deploy verification in docs.
deploy-bot: `ci/deploy/serving:v2.15` finished at 21:30 UTC — status: SUCCESS
